quotes.text: The AI-powered recommendations further improve campaign performance and lead qualification and with email, SMS, and WhatsApp communication available from one platform, we can engage customers through the channels that work best for them.
The drawback isn't that big, but it can be annoying in times that demand prompt changes, say during busy tourist season.

Another standout feature is its multi-channel marketing capabilities, enabling us to coordinate email, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns from a single platform while monitoring engagement across every channel.

I am using AC to send automated sequences to my leads, but I am not using the campaign features, and I am considering swtiching to another tool if I can't delete my inactive leads (else the costs will constantly increase)
